# ssp Provider

The **SSP** (Security Services Platform) provider manages both the SSPI appliance
(installer, bootstrapping, cluster provisioning, scaling) and deployed SSP cluster instances (site onboarding,
vertical security features activation, backup/restore, telemetry, certificates).

Configure the provider with connection details for the SSPI appliance (for installer workflows) and/or the
deployed SSP cluster host (for Day-2 operational workflows). All sensitive values can be supplied via environment
variables to avoid storing secrets in configuration files.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Base HTTPS URL of the deployed SSP platform (e.g. `https://ssp.example.com`). May also be set via the `SSP_HOST` environment variable.
- `insecure` (Boolean) When `true`, TLS certificate verification for the SSP cluster is skipped. Defaults to `false`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SSP enterprise admin password. May also be set via the `SSP_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `sspi_endpoint` (String) The API endpoint of the SSPI appliance. Can be specified with the `SSPI_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `sspi_host` (String) The base URL/host of the SSPI appliance. Can be specified with the `SSPI_HOST` environment variable.
- `sspi_insecure` (Boolean) Allow insecure TLS connections to SSPI appliance. Can be specified with the `SSPI_INSECURE` environment variable. Defaults to false.
- `sspi_password` (String, Sensitive) The local administrator password for SSPI. Can be specified with the `SSPI_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `sspi_username` (String) The local administrator username for SSPI. Can be specified with the `SSPI_USERNAME` environment variable.
- `username` (String) SSP enterprise admin username. May also be set via the `SSP_USERNAME` environment variable.
